At 7.55 a.m. 29-6-38, a telephone message was
received from Mr. Oliver (British), an employee of
the Shanghai Gas Company, Yu Ya Chin Road (英治路),
reporting that two men had been shot in the vicinity
of the Gas Company, Yu Ya Chin Road.

Inspt. Chamberlain, D.I. Bennett and all
available men immediately attended and upon arrival
at the scene found that three male Chinese were lying
on Yu Ya Chin Road, on the East side in the vicinity
of the Gas Company Offices, all of whom were suffer-
ing from bullet wounds.

The Shanghai Fire Brigade Ambulance was called,
the three injured men being taken to the Lester
Hospital, one of whom, Zung Tuh Min (陳德銘) was
found to be dead upon arrival.

The assistance of the Reserve Unit was request-
ed, the personnel of which attended under Mr. Fair-
bairn, a search of the near vicinity failing to effect
any arrests, the persons responsible for the shooting
having already decamped in an Easterly direction
along Amoy Road, which is adjacent to the Gas Company
Offices and near to the scene of the shooting.

Enquiries ascertained that the now deceased
one Zung Tuh Min (陳德銘), alias Zung Pah Liang
(陳伯亮), aged 49, is chief of the Shipping Central
Office of the Bureau of Communications of the Shang-
hai City Municipal Administration, Offices in Pootung,

1938年6月29日上午7:55，接到上海煤气公司英籍员工奥利弗先生（Mr. Oliver）的电话留言，报告在虞洽卿路（英治路）煤气公司附近发生两人被枪击事件。

张伯伦督察（Inspt. Chamberlain）、班尼特警探督察（D.I. Bennett）及所有可用警力立即赶赴现场，到达后发现三名中国男子躺在虞洽卿路东侧、煤气公司办事处附近，均遭受枪伤。

呼叫上海救火会救护车，三名伤者被送往莱斯特医院，其中一人陈德铭（Zung Tuh Min）抵达时已被证实死亡。

请求后备队支援，人员在费尔贝恩先生（Mr. Fairbairn）带领下到场，对附近区域进行搜索，未能实施任何逮捕，开枪责任人已向东逃窜，沿与煤气公司办事处相邻且靠近案发地的厦门路逃离。

I got up at 6.50 a. this morning(29-6-38).
At about 7.50 a. . even date, I was at the entrance of the
Hoong Foh Li, Yu Ya Ching Ro , when I suddenly heard two shots
fired on the foot pavement of Yu Ya Ching Road near the Shanghai
Gas Company, when at the same time, I observed a black painted
private ricksha proceeding from North to South. The ricksha
coolie fell down.
A fat male Chinese, immediately jumped out from the ricksha.
About 10 feet in front of the ricksha, there was a male Chinese,
age about 30, medium build, wearing blue cloth jacket and pants
armed with a "Mauser" pistol, who fired one shot at the fat
male Chinese.
There was also another male Chinese, age about 30, medium
build, wearing black long gown, standing about 10 feet away from
the ricksha, but I did not see whether he was armed or not.
The fat male Chinese fell on the ground and the two male
Chinese at once made good their escape towards east along Amo
Road.
I was so afraid . so I immediately left the place for home
At about 8.30 a. . when I again proceeded to the same place
I was called to this Station by detectives and made the above
statement.
The above is true.

我今天早上（1938年6月29日）6点50分起床。
大约在同日上午7点50分，我在鸭绿江路
洪福里门口，突然听到靠近上海
煤气公司的鸭绿江路人行道上响了两声枪
声，同时我看到一辆黑色的私人人力车由北向南
行驶。人力车夫倒在地上。
一名肥胖的中国男子立即从人力车上跳下来。
在人力车前方约10英尺处，有一名中国男子，
年龄约30岁，中等身材，身穿蓝色布夹克和裤子，
手持一把“毛瑟”手枪，向那名
肥胖的中国男子开了一枪。
还有另一名中国男子，年龄约30岁，中等
身材，身穿黑色长衫，站在离人力车约10英尺的地方，但我没看清他是否携带武器。
那名肥胖的中国男子倒在地上，这两名中国男子
立即沿爱多亚路向东逃窜。
我非常害怕，所以我立即离开现场回家。
大约上午8点30分，当我再次前往同一地点时，
我被探员叫到本捕房，并作了上述陈述。
以上属实。

The following is the statement of WONG YI KUNG (王义功), age 26,
native of Chinkiang taken by M. C. P. O. 516 Fong Chen Chung
at Louza Ctne. on the 23-6-38 and translated by Clerk Li Yun Pei.

I reside in let house (Number unknown), 3rd alley-way, Yoh With Li off North Yu Ya Ching Road. I am a street food-stall hawker, having a reserved stall at Lao Shan Market, French Concession.

This morning (23-6-38) I left the market for my home for the purpose of fetching some clothing and shoes. At about 7:30 a.m. whilst passing the gate of the Shanghai Gas Company, Yu Ya Ching Road, I suddenly heard one sound of gun shot. Simultaneously I saw a private ricksha coolie lying on the ground, probably having received the shot fired by a male Chinese, height about 5'8/9", bald headed, thin long face, wearing a black Indian silk long gown, in whose possession was a pistol. The person, a big fellow, wearing foreign style clothing, who was then seated in the ricksha, immediately alighted from the ricksha in a manner likely to effect the man's arrest, but the man dressed in black Indian silk long gown, successively fired three more shots at him. Another person, age about 33/4, height about 5'3/4", thin long face, sallow complexion, no hat, who was also in the vicinity, opened one shot, this resulted in the big fellow falling down to the ground. Following this the two men who fired the shots ran away in possession of their weapons, towards North on Yu Ya Ching Road, turning East on Amy Road.

This is my true statement.

Signed & cross-marked:
Wong Yi Kung.

我居住在北鸭绿江路旁耀威里（Yoh With Li，音译）第三条弄堂的出租屋内（门牌号不详）。我是一名街头食品摊贩，在法租界老西门市场有一个预留摊位。

今天早上（1938年6月23日），我离开市场回家取衣物和鞋子。大约上午7:30，当我经过鸭绿江路上海煤气公司大门时，突然听到一声枪响。同时我看到一名私人人力车夫躺在地上，可能是被一名中国男子开枪击中，该男子身高约5英尺8/9英寸，秃头，长瘦脸，身穿黑色印度丝绸长衫，手中持有一把手枪。当时坐在人力车上的一名彪形大汉，身穿西式服装，立即下车，似乎试图逮捕那人，但那名身穿黑色印度丝绸长衫的男子接连向他开了三枪。另一名男子，年龄约33/34岁，身高约5英尺3/4英寸，长瘦脸，面色蜡黄，未戴帽子，也在附近，开了一枪，导致那名彪形大汉倒在地上。随后，这两名开枪者持武器沿鸭绿江路向北逃跑，在爱多亚路转向东。

这是我的真实陈述。

签名并画十字标记：
王义功。

C.P.S. 919 Mo Nyoh Daung.

Whilst I was on duty on Yu Ya Ching Road Bridge at 7.52 a.m.
on the 29-6-38, I suddenly heard 6 or 7 shots being fired. I
immediately turned to C.P.C. 285 and stated that something
untoward must have happened at the corner of Yu Ya Ching and
Amoy Roads. I then asked C.P.C. 285 to remain on the bridge
to take care of the Japanese military launches. After drawing
my service pistol, I immediately rushed forward towards the
South. I blew the police whistle I had and when I reached
the corner of Yu Ya Ching and Amoy Roads, I observed two dead
bodies lying outside the Shanghai Gas Company on the South side
of Amoy Road. I also saw a private ricksha abandoned on the
roadway. No pedestrians could be seen in that vicinity at the
time. I then returned to the bridge where I telephoned to the
station and reported the matter. On being told that a report
had already been received at the station, I again returned to
the scene to assist.

Signed, Mo Nyoh Daung, C.P.S. 919.

华籍巡官（C.P.S.）919号 莫若当（Mo Nyoh Daung，音译）。

1938年6月29日上午7:52，当我在鸭绿江路桥上执勤时，突然听到六七声枪响。我立即转向华籍警员（C.P.C.）285号，说鸭绿江路和爱多亚路拐角处一定出了事。随后我要求华籍警员285号留在桥上照看日本军用汽艇。拔出配枪后，我立即向南冲去。我吹响了随身携带的警哨，当我到达鸭绿江路和爱多亚路的拐角处时，我看到两具尸体躺在爱多亚路南侧上海煤气公司外。我还看到一辆私人人力车被弃置在路面上。当时在该区域看不到行人。随后我返回桥上，打电话向警局报告此事。得知警局已收到报告后，我再次返回现场协助。

签名，莫若当（Mo Nyoh Daung），华籍巡官919号。
